top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §747.501(15))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information related to maintaining and administering unassigned epinephrine auto-injectors.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child in care did not have an immunization record available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three staff did not have a completed Pre-Employment Affidavit in their personnel record.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Emergencies (26 TAC §747.501(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies are missing procedures for handling medical emergencies.

top_violation_types.title: Animals - Notify Parents in Writing (26 TAC §747.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: While review the operational policy there was no notification to the parents  of an animal being present at the home.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include infant safe sleep.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Release of Children (26 TAC §747.501(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have operational policies available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.
